symptom: chief_engineer.semantic_repair_exhausted after the frozen candidate entered semantic patch repair
evidence: The primary structured-output request used the required tool and reached schema repair.
Schema repair froze a candidate containing 11 artifacts.
The semantic repair provider call also returned one structured tool call.
Patch application rejected a self-consumer invariant before Director dispatch.
root_cause: The final provider request did contain the exact invariant-level violations. The provider repaired the unknown obligation references and the original TASK-3 self-consumer, but introduced TASK-2 as both owner and consumer of INV-NOTE-PITCH-MAP. Primary CE output already had a safe deterministic recovery that removes an owner only when a real external consumer remains; the semantic-patch provider parser did not reuse that rule and rejected the whole otherwise useful patch.

fix.behavior: At the semantic-patch Provider trust boundary, remove owner_task_id from consumer_task_ids only when at least one external consumer remains; owner-only rows remain invalid.

next_action: Run fresh isolated L3-22 r24 and prove the Chief Engineer stage consumes the recovered semantic patch before evaluating the next exact boundary.
